note: City of Mott RV park on the west edge of town: a gravel strip of sites along the south side of an open park lawn. A small, plain lot. --Claude
summary: City of Mott parks page read: Westside Trailer Park is a city-managed park, $30/night full service (30 or 50 amp, water, sewer), reservations by phone 701-260-2675; hookups/booking/fees confirmed (fees note dropped as redundant). HHS licenses it to the Mott Park District as a 'trailer park/campground' (12 lots). Imagery shows an empty gravel pad row, not a residential trailer court; no seasonal or monthly rate is posted. Google 1.0 from 1 review (not a gate: local, and under 25). Pin ok.
flags: LONG-STAY (name says 'trailer park'): the five tests read clean. (1) No seasonal/annual lots advertised; (2) a nightly rate is posted by the city ($30) and nothing else; (3) no homes or lots for sale; (4) the only sale the city describes is nightly; (5) imagery shows the gravel pad strip at the pin empty (individual pads hard to count; small markers along it), with no skirted homes, decks or sheds in it (two skirted mobile homes ~120 m east sit on separate residential lots beside houses, outside the gravel row). HHS licenses it as 'WEST MOTT TRAILER PARK/CAMPGROUND', 12 lots, Mott Park District. Keep; occupancy could not be measured (phone booking only).

OWNERSHIP: local stands (City of Mott page lists it among the city parks it manages; HHS owner Mott Park District). Not private, so the price gate and Google rule do not apply. Google 1.0 stars from 1 review (review text not read).
PIN: stored 46.37063,-102.33481 sits on the gravel pad strip south of the park lawn: ok.
PHONE: stored 701-260-2675 is the reservation contact the city page gives: keep. Google shows 701-824-2375 (not on any city page); City Hall is 701-824-2163.
WEBSITE: keep https://www.discovermott.com/parks-recreation (the city's own page). Google links an ndtourism listing instead.

UNSTATED: season, site count (HHS 12 lots), lengths, restrooms/showers/dump are not on the city page. The pads are open gravel back-ins along an open lot with no visible length constraint; fit not in doubt.
HORSES (AWH rule 2026-11-12): the City of Mott parks page is silent on horses; no horse facilities visible. Not a horse campground; keep.
